welcome.title: Welcome to Forecast-in-a-Box
welcome.body: Run state-of-the-art AI weather forecasts on your own hardware, with free open data. This short tour covers the essentials — about two minutes.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard, at a glance
dashboard.body: The Overview page surfaces system status, downloaded models, and a journal of recent and scheduled forecasts — plus ready-made starting points for your first run.

blocks.title: Compose forecasts from blocks
blocks.body: A forecast is a pipeline. A source provides the data — an Anemoi model, an operational forecast, or a source a plugin adds. Transforms select parameters, products compute statistics, and one run can fan out to several outputs. Connect blocks on the canvas; configure each in the side panel.

execution.title: Run it, then inspect results in place
execution.body: Every submitted workflow becomes an execution record: the resolved configuration graph on the left, with outputs, logs, task graph, and the full run specification in tabs on the right.

viewer.title: Visualise and compare on the map
viewer.body: Stored GRIB outputs render as WMS layers in the integrated viewer — no downloads. Load two sources as A and B, compare them in several modes, and step through lead times on a shared timeline. External WMS-compatible servers — even third-party ones — can be linked in for comparison.

activate.title: Run your first forecast
activate.body: Pick a starting preset — it opens pre-configured in the workflow builder, ready to adjust and run. You can save your own presets later.

activate.empty: No starter presets are available yet — you can still start from a blank canvas.
